chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from his grandfather, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The house of the devils among your houses is the house of the spider.'
ai.seo_question: What is the 'house of the devils' in a Muslim home according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) metaphorically identifies the spider's web as the 'house of the devils,' a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegetical tradition as a sign of spiritual neglect and stagnation within the home. This imagery underscores the importance of maintaining both physical cleanliness and spiritual vigilance, as accumulated cobwebs symbolize the dwelling place of Shayatin in areas where dhikr and activity have ceased.
